data.narrative:
Cohesive Robotics is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by David Pietrocola that has raised $5M+. The valuation analysis draws on a broader robotics and manufacturing comp universe of nine private companies and one public equity (277810.KQ), including peers such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics.

A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the robotics sector—only one same-stage peer was identified in the filtered dataset, falling short of the three-company minimum threshold for reliable triangulation. The single applicable method is stage-progression, which applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $5M raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $12M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, centered at $12M. Key uncertainties include the thin peer dataset available for robotics at the seed stage, limiting cross-validation of the stage-progression assumption, and the reliance on total capital raised as a valuation proxy absent disclosed recent financing rounds. A subsequent funding event or access to additional seed-stage robotics comparables would materially refine this range.
